name: Moreno Valley Mall
summary: Old-school retail complex offering brand-name stores, a food court, a multiplex cinema & bowling.
description: Moreno Valley Mall is a regional shopping destination featuring a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment including the Harkins Theatres MV 16. Located at Town Circle in Moreno Valley, the mall offers extended holiday hours and serves as the primary retail hub for the Inland Empire community.
demographics: Moreno Valley Mall serves a predominantly middle-income, family-oriented demographic in the Inland Empire region with a high percentage of Hispanic and African American households. The trade area attracts young families and value-conscious shoppers, with typical visitors aged 25-45 seeking affordable fashion, entertainment, and dining options. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for mainstream retailers and family-friendly activities, with strong weekend traffic from surrounding communities including Riverside and Perris.
